name: AP_REPORTING_ENTITIES_ALL
description: AP_REPORTING_ENTITIES_ALL contains information about the reporting entities you define for 1099 reporting.  You must define at least one reporting entity for your company or agency; however, you can define as many reporting entities as you require to satisfy your multi-organization reporting needs.  Each tax reporting entity you define must have a unique Tax Identification Number.  When you submit your 1099 reports, you submit the reports once for each tax reporting entity you define. This table corresponds to the Reporting Entity window.

columns.name: TAX_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Reporting entity identifier that identifies a reporting entity for tax reporting.

columns.name: TAX_IDENTIFICATION_NUM
columns.description: Tax identification number for reporting entity

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the reporting entity for tax reporting.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location identifier for reporting entity

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
